name: ZCA_ROLLUPS_SNAPSHOT
description: This is a temporary dynamic table that stores the snapshot of the eligible rollups from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table that needs to be processed by data refresh job.

columns.name: ROLLUP_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the rollup. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the source object. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: OBJECT_ROLLUP_TABLE
columns.description: Name of the table where calculated rollup data of the source object would be stored. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK_COLUMN
columns.description: Database column name of the source object's primary key.

columns.name: ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: Rollup attribute type. Supported values are NUMBER and TIMESTAMP. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: ATTR_DB_COLUMN
columns.description: Rollup attribute database column name.

columns.name: REFRESH_TYPE
columns.description: Stores current rollup refresh type Full,Incremental,Hierarchy

columns.name: HIERARCHY_ATTR_DB_COLUMN
columns.description: Hierarchy attribute database column name.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_DB_COLUMN
columns.description: Dynamically assigned database column from ZCA_ROLLUP_CALCULATION table.

columns.name: FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Aggregation function code that would be used to calculate the rollup data. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: COMPILED_SOURCE_AMT_CONV
columns.description: Generated expression to convert the amount field value to corporate currency. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: COMPILED_SQL
columns.description: Generated refresh SQL that would be used to calculate the rollup values. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.

columns.name: CAL_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Calculation batch identifier.

columns.name: CAL_START_TIME
columns.description: Calculation process start time.

columns.name: CAL_PHASE1_END_TIME
columns.description: Phase 1 calculation process end time.

columns.name: CAL_PHASE2_END_TIME
columns.description: Phase 2 calculation process end time.

columns.name: CAL_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Number of rows created by calculation process.

columns.name: CAL_STATUS
columns.description: Calculation process status.

columns.name: NUM_OF_UPDATE_BATCH
columns.description: Count of update batches.

columns.name: NUM_OF_UPDATE_BATCH_LEFT
columns.description: Count of update batches left to be processed.

columns.name: UPDATE_START_TIME
columns.description: Update process start time.

columns.name: UPDATE_END_TIME
columns.description: Update process end time.

columns.name: UPDATE_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Number of rows updated by the update process.

columns.name: UPDATE_STATUS
columns.description: Update process status.

columns.name: HIER_UPDATE_START_TIME
columns.description: Hierarchy update process start time.

columns.name: HIER_UPDATE_END_TIME
columns.description: Hierarchy update process end time.

columns.name: HIER_UPDATE_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Number of rows updated by the hierarchy update process.

columns.name: HIER_UPDATE_STATUS
columns.description: Hierarchy update process status.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message returned during the process.
